Kuvitus: lapsi seisoo keinulla puistossa: Illustration: a child stands on a swing in a park on a summer day and swings back and forth. The two extreme positions of the swing are shown as faint dashed lines on both sides of the swing, and the middle, lowest position is drawn solid. Behind the swing frame there are birches and rolling hills.
Kaavakuva kahdesta värähtelijästä. Vasem: Schematic figure of two oscillating objects. On the left a weight hangs from a spring. The solid weight is at the equilibrium position, where a horizontal dashed line x = 0 passes, and the dashed weights are at the highest and the lowest position. From the equilibrium position to each extreme position there is an arrow of equal length labelled A. The vertical x axis points up. On the right a pendulum: a weight hangs from a string, and at the equilibrium position the string is vertical along the dashed line x = 0. The dashed weights are at the extreme positions on the left and on the right, and from the equilibrium position to each there is a horizontal arrow A.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: punnuksen poikkea: Graph to scale: displacement x of a weight in centimetres as a function of time t from zero to two seconds. The curve is a sine curve that rises from zero to the highest value 4 cm at 0.2 s, falls to the lowest value minus 4 cm at 0.6 s and repeats in the same way. At the top a double-headed arrow T between two successive peaks from 0.2 s to 1.0 s, at the bottom another arrow T between two successive passes through the equilibrium position going up from 0.8 s to 1.6 s. On the right a vertical arrow A from the equilibrium position to the peak.
Kaavakuva: vasemmalla piste kiertää vast: Schematic figure: on the left a point moves anticlockwise round a circle of radius A. The point has turned from the horizontal radius through the angle 2 pi t per T. The height of the point above the level of the centre of the circle is x. A horizontal dashed line carries the same height to the graph on the right, where x is drawn as a function of time t for one period T: the sine curve takes the value A at a quarter of T, the value zero at half of T, the value minus A at three quarters of T and zero again at T.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: simuloidut mittau: Graph to scale: simulated measured points, the displacement x of a weight in centimetres as a function of time t from zero to four seconds at tenth-of-a-second intervals. The points vary between about plus and minus three centimetres, and a blue sine curve has been drawn through them. At the bottom a double-headed arrow for the time of three full oscillations from zero to 3.6 seconds, labelled 3T is 3.6 s. On the right a vertical arrow A from the equilibrium position to the level of the peak of the curve, 3 cm.
Kuvaaja: punnuksen poikkeama x senttimet: Graph: displacement x of a weight in centimetres as a function of time t from zero to three seconds. The vertical axis has grid lines at half-centimetre intervals and values as whole centimetres from minus three to three, the time axis has grid lines at 0.2-second intervals. The curve is a sine curve that starts from zero going up and oscillates on both sides of the equilibrium position. The first peak is at 0.3 s and lies on the grid line halfway between two and three centimetres; the troughs are at the same distance below the equilibrium position.
Kuvaaja: ilmatyynyradan vaunun poikkeama: Graph: displacement x of a cart on an air track in centimetres as a function of time t from zero to three seconds, with grid lines on the time axis at 0.25-second intervals and values at half-second intervals. The curve is a sine curve that starts from zero going up and oscillates all the time in the same way on both sides of the equilibrium position. The peaks lie on the grid line 3 cm and the troughs on the grid line minus 3 cm, and the curve crosses the dashed line of the equilibrium position at every grid line of the time axis.
Kuvaaja: heilurin punnuksen vaakasuora p: Graph: horizontal displacement x of the bob of a pendulum in centimetres as a function of time t from zero to 5.4 seconds, with grid lines and values on the time axis at 0.9-second intervals. The curve is a sine curve that starts from zero going up, reaches its greatest value 5 cm and its smallest value minus 5 cm, and crosses the dashed line of the equilibrium position at every grid line of the time axis.
